description: Web search. Send a query; returns up to 20 ranked Google web results with title, URL, snippet and date where known. Use when an agent needs links to read or to check what exists on the web. Not for reading page content (use /v1/fetch-page) or for a written answer (use /v1/research-answer). Typical response 1 to 2 s. Failed calls are not charged. Costs $0.01 (USDC, x402).

country.description: Optional two-letter country code, lower case.

num.description: How many results to return, 1 to 20.

query.description: Search terms, as typed into a search engine.

name: quantagentshop_web_search
title: Web search
